headline: Approved $1,929,136.49 in August retiree payroll and tabled PTO buyback guidelines to October 27.
summary: Approved Patrick G. Haverty's retirement, effective September 27, 2026, and admitted eight new school employees. Tabled changes to vacation and PTO buyback guidelines until October 27, 2026. Also approved three payment warrants and the August 25, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved the August 2026 retiree payroll warrant totaling $1,929,136.49, 5-0.
Approved the September 2026 cash disbursements warrant totaling $18,002.49, 5-0.
Approved the September 2026 refunds, rollovers, and transfers warrant totaling $113,419.86, 5-0.
Approved Patrick G. Haverty's Option C superannuation retirement effective September 27, 2026, 5-0.
Approved admitting eight new school employees to membership, 5-0.
Tabled updating guidelines for vacation and PTO buybacks to October 27, 2026.
Took no position on the home rule petition from Marissa Fleming to let a City Councilor purchase prior elected service.

decision_evidence.quote: On a motion made by Anna Farrell and seconded by Mary Cringan, to approve the August 2026 Retiree Payroll Warrant. Voted unanimously (5-0).
On a motion made by Mary Cringan and seconded by Anna Farrell, to approve the September 2026 Cash Disbursements Warrant. Voted unanimously (5-0).
On a motion made by Jacquelyn Cronin and seconded by John Brown, to approve the September 2026 Refunds/Rollovers/Transfers Warrant. Voted unanimously (5-0).
On a motion made by John Brown and seconded by Mary Cringan, to approve the August 25, 2026 Meeting Minutes. Voted unanimously (5 -0).
On a motion made by Anna Farrell and seconded by Mary Cringan, to approve Patrick G. Haverty's Option C, Superannuation Retirement effective September 27, 2026. Voted unanimously (5-0).
On a motion made by Mary Cringan and seconded by Anna Farrell, to admit to membership the new members listed. Voted unanimously (5-0).
Matter tabled to October 27, 2026 Board Meeting.
The Board takes no position on the petition and, should it be enacted into law, will comply with its applicable provisions.
